name: mcp-bideetmusique
description: MCP server for Bide & Musique. Search the hand-built catalogue of forgotten French songs. No API key required.
long_description: Search Bide & Musique along one axis at a time, read a record with its year, label, writers and the words its page publishes, read an artist's page, draw a record at random, and see what the collection has just catalogued. No API key, no account, read-only.

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Search the collection along one named axis.

tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Read one record, with the words its page publishes.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Read an artist's page and what the collection holds of them.

tools.name: get_random_song
tools.description: Read a record drawn at random from the collection.

tools.name: list_new_songs
tools.description: Read what the collection has just catalogued.
